infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_opposition: Allies you treat gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% damage resistance until the end of the mission.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_essentialdignity: When the target is below ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% health, your healing applied to them is ‖color:gui.green‖2.2‖end‖ times more effective.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_lightspeed: When someone aboard the submarine is unconscious, you gain ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% movement speed. Your CPR is slightly more effective.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_aspectedhelios: While you are inside the submarine, crew members within ‖color:gui.green‖1000‖end‖ units slowly heal over time, continuously reducing ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.orange‖bleeding‖end‖.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_stargate: When the mission begins, every crew member gains a charge of Celestial Stasis.\nWhen a crew member is knocked down (unconscious), their charge is automatically consumed: their injuries are fully healed.\nEach crew member can trigger this once per mission.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_opposition: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% damage resistance until the end of the mission.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_stargate: You cannot die from your wounds, and your injuries will be fully healed once you are knocked down. The charge is consumed on use.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_balance: All crew members deal ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% more ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_spear: All crew members gain ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖melee attack speed‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖ranged attack speed‖end‖.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% / ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arrow: All crew members gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖movement speed‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖swimming speed‖end‖.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% / ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_bole: All crew members gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% damage resistance.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_spire: All crew members gain ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖repair speed‖end‖ (mechanical and electrical) and ‖color:gui.orange‖hull welding‖end‖ speed.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_ewer: All crew members consume ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% less ‖color:gui.orange‖oxygen‖end‖.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_astrodyne: Astrodyne empowers every Arcanum card you have unlocked, increasing each card's effect by ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖%.\nOnly cards you have actually unlocked are affected — the more you invest, the more you gain.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_balance: You deal ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% more damage.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_balance_boost: Astrodyne: you deal a further ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖% more damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spear: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% melee attack speed and ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% ranged attack speed.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% / ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spear_boost: Astrodyne: a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% melee and ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖% ranged attack speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_arrow: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% movement speed and ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% swimming speed.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% / ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_arrow_boost: Astrodyne: a further ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖% movement and ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% swimming speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_bole: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% damage resistance.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spire: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% repair speed (mechanical and electrical) and hull welding speed.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spire_boost: Astrodyne: a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% repair and hull welding speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ewer: You consume ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% less oxygen.\nAstrodyne raises this to ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ewer_boost: Astrodyne: you consume a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% less oxygen.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_astrolabe: Gain an Astrolabe — a small hand-held ranged weapon.\nIt fires a ‖color:gui.orange‖beam of starlight‖end‖ that hits instantly and applies ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖.\nRequires no ammunition. It occupies both hands, so you must take it out of your inventory to use it.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_astrolabe: An astrologer's star-reading instrument, small enough to fit in a pocket.\nRaise it and starlight bends into a beam. Its power never runs out — no ammunition of any kind is needed.\nAstrologians are versed in Combust, so whatever it strikes keeps burning.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_earthlystar: Gain an Earthly Star, and unlock its fabrication recipe. Place it on the ground and it spends ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ seconds gathering starlight. After that, the moment the room it sits in starts ‖color:gui.orange‖flooding‖end‖, it blooms: a single burst that repairs the hull within ‖color:gui.green‖250‖end‖ units, then it fades away. Each Earthly Star works only once — you must fabricate a new one.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_earthlystar: A star not yet lit. Leave it on the ground and starlight slowly gathers. Once charged, it needs only to be submerged: it blooms, mends the hull around it, and fades. It cannot foresee harm — it can only be placed in advance. The timing is everything.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: Gain a Wheel of Fortune, and unlock its fabrication recipe. Throw it at your crew. It shatters on impact, granting every crew member within ‖color:gui.green‖400‖end‖ units ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% damage resistance for ‖color:gui.green‖8‖end‖ seconds, and continuously reducing their ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.orange‖bleeding‖end‖ while it lasts. It is consumed on use — you must fabricate a new one.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: A wheel cast from the tracks of stars. Thrown, it shatters on the ground and leaves a brief stretch of good fortune behind. For 8 seconds, those it covers take half damage while their wounds and bleeding ebb away. It does not tell friend from foe — fortune never picks.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% damage resistance, and your wounds and bleeding are slowly ebbing away.
